Definition: to do, make, prepare, keep, etc.
BiblicalUsage: 1) to make, do; 1a)(P'al); 1a1) to make, create; 1a2) to do, perform; 1b) (Ithp'al); 1b1) to be made into; 1b2) to be done, be wrought, be performed, be executed, be carried out
